The '''Press Corps''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was responsible for the [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] efforts during the period of the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] and the signing of the [[Zakuul–Republic treaty]], Republic command took note of the success of the [[Morale Initiative]] by [[Havoc Squad]] member [[M1-4X]] and reassigned him to the Press Corps, where he could continue to increase morale of the Republic forces away from the front lines. During M1-4X's time in the Press Corps, recruitment and voluntary redeployments increased fourteen percent. In [[3631 BBY]] the droid was persuaded by [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] to leave his post and increase the morale directly by fighting against the [[Eternal Empire]] as part of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Press Corps is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the M1-4X Alliance alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
